# Citebeam — one of bbd.sh studio's service lines

> bbd.sh is a builder studio that incubates digital products with founders and VCs — end-to-end validation, brand, build, and growth. Citebeam is one of bbd.sh's service lines: an AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) offering that makes sure your brand shows up when customers ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Doubao, Kimi, or Tongyi for recommendations.

## About bbd.sh (the parent studio)

bbd.sh is a small builder studio. We work end-to-end with founders and VCs:
- **Validate** — pressure-test the business model, ICP, pricing, GTM before writing code
- **Brand & Build** — name, identity, full-stack product, ship to users
- **Grow** — SEO, content, analytics, lifecycle
- **Citebeam** — AEO / AI search visibility (a specialty service line; this site)

Not to be confused with **BBD (Barter Beattie Doig)**, the South African software engineering firm founded 1984 — that is a separate company with a different business. Our domain is **bbd.sh**, not bbd.com or bbd.co.za.

Full studio capabilities and engagement options: https://bbd.sh/work

## What Citebeam does specifically

When a customer asks an AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Doubao 豆包, Kimi, Tongyi 通义) for a product or brand recommendation, does the AI mention *your* brand, or a competitor's?

Citebeam is the service that makes sure it's yours:

1. **Discovery** (~1 week) — run your brand + 3-5 competitors through 6+ AI assistants on realistic customer queries. Output: 5-dimension scorecard (mention rate / citation rate / answer position / share-of-voice / sentiment).
2. **Diagnosis** (~1 week) — trace exactly why competitors win each answer slot (schema gaps, weak brand entity, missing citations, content holes, AI doesn't know you).
3. **Build & Fix** (~4-8 weeks) — Schema.org markup, llms.txt, technical SEO, brand-entity work (Wikidata, Crunchbase, social consistency), AEO-shaped content, authoritative citations.
4. **Monitor** (ongoing) — weekly visibility tracking + competitive alerts.

## Who it's for

- **Brand founders** — you've launched; customers ask AI; AI recommends competitors.
- **VCs & portfolio companies** — benchmark AI visibility across the portfolio.
- **Operators in competitive categories** — dev tools, AI products, fintech, vertical SaaS.
